With the advent of Christianity, the name gained an additional layer of meaning as it combined the old pagan Slavic god Dzien with the Christian belief of God, signifying a profound blend of spiritual influences.

This name serves as a constant reminder of the power and relevance of the divine in our lives, and encourages individuals to seek divine guidance and grace.
